63:t_10:46.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ＡＧ$$ is gone... Who will guide people around the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ now?」

63:t_10:47.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Can't be helped... Should we do it ourselves today?」

63:t_10:49.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Then let's give it our all again today...!」

64:t_000:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「All units are in position.」

64:t_000:1.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$n! I'm leaving it to you to back $$レド$$ up!」

64:t_000:2.en:
$n
「Figures it would end up like this in the end...」

64:t_000:4.en:
$$アル$$
「Are you jealous that your friend was taken from you?」

64:t_000:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「...You and that $$チェインバー#pilot$$ character don't seem to have been discussing anything useful.」

64:t_000:6.en:
$$アル$$
「Not necessarily. The way $$チェインバー#pilot$$ functions as a Pilot Support Enlightenment Interface System was a great reference for me as well.」

64:t_000:8.en:
$$アル$$
「Yes. $$チェインバー#pilot$$'s role seems to be to perfect a pilot as a soldier.」

64:t_000:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「Being trained by someone you respect, of all things... That man $$レド$$ has my sympathy.」

64:t_000:10.en:
$$アル$$
「Please also consider the misfortune of an AI whose partner favors stubborn, inefficient tactics.」

64:t_000:12.en:
$$アル$$
「It was a joke to ease the tension before the operation. After all, this looks set to be our first large-scale battle in a long time.」

64:t_000:14.en:
$$リジット$$
「Can you hear me, $$レド$$?」

64:t_000:15.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This appears to be a complex discussion, so I will converse as the interpreter.」

64:t_000:16.en:
$$リジット$$
「Either is fine. Do you understand the purpose of this operation?」

64:t_000:17.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I understand. I intend to refrain from killing or wounding wherever possible.」

64:t_000:18.en:
$$リジット$$
「One more question. With your military power, couldn't you annihilate this $$ガルガンティア船団$$?」

64:t_000:19.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Affirmative. Setting $c aside, this unit alone is capable of wiping out the fleet.」

64:t_000:20.en:
$$リジット$$
「Then why would you try to help people as fragile as us? I hear you were not forced to sortie.」

64:t_000:21.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「...A person named $$ベローズ$$ told me the people here 'give fresh water to the one who brings back fish,' and that pirates do not keep that rule.」

64:t_000:22.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Therefore, I judge that there is a path to negotiation with you.」

64:t_000:24.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I wish to remain stationed here for a while. I want support to that end.」

64:t_000:25.en:
$$リジット$$
「...Understood. I will take responsibility for conveying your request to the Fleet Commander.」

64:t_000:26.en:
$n
「$$レド$$... What were you talking about?」

64:t_000:27.en:
$$レド$$
「It's a talk a-bout li-ving he-re.」

64:t_000:30.en:
$n
「No... Sorry to be saying this now, but I just realized you're the same as us.」

64:t_000:32.en:
$$テッサ$$
「To all hands. I will take command of this operation.」

64:t_000:33.en:
$$テッサ$$
「According to the scouting report, the pirates' 《$$ユンボロ$$》 units overwhelmingly outnumber us.」

64:t_000:34.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Per unit, our strength is superior, but we are at an overwhelming disadvantage in numbers, and at the same time we must protect the fleet.」

64:t_000:35.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And, with the future in mind, we need to show the pirates our strength.」

64:t_000:36.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「That's the idea. We'll shoot down every enemy that approaches the fleet, one after another.」

64:t_000:37.en:
$$クルツ$$
($$テッサ$$'s oddly tense, but isn't $$クルーゾー$$ pretty wound up too...)

64:t_000:38.en:
$$マオ$$
(Never mind $$ベン$$, but I'm a little worried about $$テッサ$$...)

64:t_000:39.en:
$$マオ$$
(I'm sure Lieutenant Colonel $$マデューカス$$ has noticed it too, though...)

64:t_000:41.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The main battlefield is the sea. To live up to Captain $$ジェフリー$$, who entrusted me with command, I must win.」

64:t_000:42.en:
$$マデューカス$$
(I may not have seen the Captain like this since her first battle...)

64:t_000:43.en:
$$マデューカス$$
(So these three months of fighting have worn her down in mind and body after all...)

64:t_000:44.en:
$$ルカ$$
「$$海賊$$ units confirmed...! Entering combat range!」

64:t_001:0.en:
$$ボス$$
「That's a crazy number of them!」

64:t_001:1.en:
$$ヌケ$$
「And on top of that, they're in the water, where we're no good!」

64:t_001:2.en:
$$ムチャ$$
「Hold on a second! Why are there even $$ネオ・ジオン$$ mobile suits mixed in with them!?」

64:t_001:3.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Those were excavated from 《$$マウンテンサイクル$$》.」

64:t_001:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「You mean the ruins that were all over 《$$ＵＣＷ$$》?」

64:t_001:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah, that's right. Machines from the past get dug up there.」

64:t_001:6.en:
$$クルツ$$
「What's that supposed to mean? Sure, that amphibious unit is a relic, but it's not pottery or a fossil, you know.」

64:t_001:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「The world we came from was actually the far future of the era when $$ジオン$$ existed.」

64:t_001:8.en:
$$ガロード$$
「When the $$大時空震動$$ made it part of 《$$ＵＣＷ$$》, that's why things like those turn up inside the ruins.」

64:t_001:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「How they were obtained doesn't matter. First we annihilate the enemy force.」

64:t_001:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have heard the Captain's plan. We do not kill or wound enemy pilots wherever possible.」

64:t_001:12.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[I cannot find logical significance in this course of action.]

64:t_001:13.en:
$$レド$$
[It's what the operation commander decided. We have no choice but to follow it.]

64:t_001:14.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, intercept the pirates! Let's hit them one after another to show them our strength!」

64:t_001:16.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I know. The enemy leader, $$ラケージ$$, is most likely waiting in the rear.」

64:t_001:17.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And this battle... will not end unless I am the one to defeat her, the woman they call the Empress.」

64:t_002:0.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Confirming a unit approaching at high speed from the rear!」

64:t_002:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It seems the main event has arrived.」

64:t_003:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. That command unit's course is presumed to be for the $$ガルガンティア船団$$.」

64:t_003:3.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Now then... are you all ready?」

64:t_004:0.en:
$$海賊$$
「It's been ages since we got to see $$ラケージ$$ ride the waves!」
